scope: Two-stage stability function and second-order consistency for smooth autonomous ODEs. Does not prove stiff order,positivity or physical convergence.
A_stability: On z=i*y, denominator modulus squared minus numerator modulus squared equals gamma^4*y^4>=0; the only pole is in the right half-plane.
conservation: Apply each stage to gas total internal energy and the photon occupation with identical source and boundary weights; absorption/emission cancels in their sum.
